rejection.details:
We find your petition unclear as it begins by calling for one thing and ends by calling for other things - and the title only reflect one part of what you are calling for.

We do already have petitions open on early releae here:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions?state=open&q=early+release

You may also be interested in signing these two petitions that align with what you are calling for in the second part of your petition:

Deport all foreign-born criminals & individuals on the terror watchlist: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/764402

Withdraw from the ECHR and replace with domestic human rights legislation: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779881
